query:
UPDATE teachers
                SET 
                    last_name = $1,
                    first_name = $2,
                    last_name_kana = $3,
                    first_name_kana = $4,
                    phone = $5,
                    mobile_phone = $6,
                    email = $7,
                    post_code1 = $8,
                    post_code2 = $9,
                    prefecture = $10,
                    city = $11,
                    street_address = $12,
                    building = $13,
                    prefectures_kana = $14,
                    city_kana = $15,
                    building_kana = $16,
                    hire_date = $17
                WHERE user_id = $18::UUID AND id = $19::UUID
                RETURNING id
